home.kicker: Built by the design team behind OrlaDent
home.headline: Design mill-ready restorations yourself — the same way we do it for labs across the US and Europe.
home.subhead: A complete Exocad training system for new grads and practicing dentists, taught by the designer whose workflow OrlaDent's own clients already trust.
home.ctaPrimary: Get the free Single Crown lesson
home.problem1: You didn't get into dentistry to wait on a lab.
home.problem2: Every case you send out is a case you don't control — the turnaround, the fit, the fix when something's off. And every hour you spend guessing your way through Exocad tutorials is an hour you're not billing.
home.problem3: We built this course because we saw the same gap from the other side: labs paying us to design cases their own team should've been able to handle in-house — if anyone had actually taught them the software the right way.
home.instructor1: Badr didn't learn Exocad to make a course. He learned it to run OrlaDent — the design partner labs and clinics across the US and Europe outsource their hardest cases to, every day, at production speed.
home.instructor2: This course is the same workflow, the same margin standards, the same eye for occlusion and esthetics that OrlaDent's clients already pay for — just taught, step by step, instead of delivered as a finished file.
home.instructor3: We're not teaching theory. We're teaching the exact process behind cases that are already in production right now, for real clients, on the other side of the world.
home.curriculumNote: Shown by learning block, not folder number — case types build on each other.
home.curriculumFooter: All modules ship to your account as they're released — lifetime access means you're never locked out of new content.
home.comparisonNote: What you get instead is stronger: real QC review of your case files, by OrlaDent's own team.
home.partnerNote: Production Partner is capped at 3 seats for the first cohort — this is a live stress test of the mentorship format before it's offered at scale. Anyone interested should expect a conversation with Badr before enrolling, not a self-checkout.
home.included1: Every module, from your first margin line to full-arch implant cases
home.included2: Downloadable checklists you can keep open next to Exocad while you work
home.included3: Real QC review of your case files — by Badr or an OrlaDent production designer, not an automated checklist
home.included4: A community of dentists and techs learning the same system, not a solo download
home.included5: Direct access to Badr for the questions a video can't answer
home.pricing2: Every tier is available on a payment plan. Pick what works for your budget, not just your ambition.
home.finalTitle: Learn the workflow. Keep the control.
home.finalBody: You can keep sending your hardest cases somewhere else and hoping they come back right — or you can learn to design them yourself, taught by the team labs across the US and Europe already trust with theirs.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: I've never touched Exocad — is this for me?
faq.a1: Yes. Module 0 walks you through the interface, workspace setup, and your first scan import before we touch a single case type.
faq.q2: I'm already a working dentist — is this worth my time?
faq.a2: If you're currently outsourcing or slow-walking through cases yourself, this course pays for itself the first time it saves you one outsourced case fee.
faq.q3: Is this the same training OrlaDent's design team actually uses?
faq.a3: Yes — this is Badr's own production workflow, the one behind cases OrlaDent delivers to clients today. Nothing here is theoretical.
faq.a4: Yes, on Foundation and Freelance Ready — 3 instalments. Paying in instalments comes to about 10% more than paying in full; both figures are printed next to every plan so you can do the maths before you choose. Production Partner pricing is set individually with each pilot student.
